name: Hy-Memory-30B-A3B

lineage.base_model: Hy3-A3B Base (named as a baseline in the benchmark table; config model_type hy_v3)
lineage.how_derived: two-stage training inside deployed memory harnesses: Memory On-Policy Distillation (dense teacher supervision on student-written memory states), then Attributed Memory Reinforcement Learning with chunk-level credit

purpose: A compact long-term-memory writer (about 3B active): it executes the write path inside external memory frameworks (Mem0, MemOS, Hy-Memory, also EverMemOS unseen), deciding what to retain, how precisely, and how new evidence updates the persistent memory bank. It replaces the general-purpose LLM inside those frameworks.

license.name: Apache-2.0
license.notes: LICENSE file read (HF raw, 2026-11-19): Tencent notice stating Apache-2.0 with no additional restrictions, followed by the standard Apache-2.0 text. No territory exclusion (unlike other Tencent model licenses).

architecture.why_this_design: The card gives no architecture reasons (a model-card claim of 256K is the base context; a maintainer states it was trained on 8K-token chunks and advises short inputs). A community port notes that config.json carries moe_intermediate_size 1536 but the real expert width is expert_hidden_dim 768 (HF discussion 4).

variants.notes: an official FP8 repo tencent/Hy-Memory-30B-A3B-FP8 exists (size not recorded)
Q5_K_M 21.37, Q6_K 24.71, Q8_0 31.99; 114k downloads; also NVFP4, exl3 4.08 bpw and MLX builds by others

pc-12gb.notes: 18.2 GB file, experts stream from RAM, 3 B active

mac-16-24gb.notes: 18.2 GB against about 12 GB GPU share

other: community llama.cpp-format GGUF, exl3, MLX and a C++/CUDA NVFP4 port
engine_support.notes: GGUF repo by a community author exists; architecture support in llama.cpp not verified. Quirks reported in discussion 4: no CR token, no byte tokens for invalid UTF-8 lead bytes.

benchmarks.name: Cross-harness memory macro average (four harnesses, six metrics each, fixed 20 % subsample)
benchmarks.unit: (Claude Opus 5 54.62, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 53.64, Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 50.37, Hy3-A3B base 47.66)

strengths: Beats much larger or closed models as a memory writer on the vendor's matrix, including a held-out framework
Small active size makes a local memory writer cheap
Apache-2.0 with a clean license file
weaknesses: Special-purpose: it writes memory, it is not a chat or coding assistant
Vendor benchmark on a 20 % subsample with the vendor's own harness; the evaluation changes only the writer
Trained on 8K-token chunks; long inputs are discouraged by a maintainer
soft.behavior: No-think mode used in the quickstart for extracting facts as JSON memory lists; the writer decides retention and updates.
best_for: local long-term memory for agents (Mem0, MemOS style)

user_reports.summary: Port to an independent C++/CUDA engine with NVFP4: config quirks (expert width 768 not 1536) and tokenizer gaps documented against the BF16 oracle

soft.maturity: Tencent Hunyuan release with a technical report (arXiv 2610.22196); GGUF community repo about 114k downloads.

tona_fit.reason: Interesting building block for an agent memory tier (3B active, Apache-2.0, fits 12 to 32 GB classes), but not a coding model; relevant only if Tona grows a long-term-memory feature. The Hy3 MoE architecture is not implemented.
